name: Krys Ra El
abstract_title: Ether Physics & The Trinary Framework. A Resonant based model for Consciousness and its Technological ,Biophysical, Ecological & Social applications.
abstract: Consciousness research stands at a crossroads: existing models offer valuable insights, yet none adequately bridge subjective experience, biophysical mechanisms, and the large-scale coherence patterns observable in living systems. This work introduces Ether Physics, an emerging framework proposing that consciousness arises from — and interacts with — a primary medium of resonance underlying physical processes.
